verdict.rationale: Bland documents voice cloning capability ("Pick a built-in voice, clone your own" and a note that a clean ~10-second sample sets the quality ceiling), which supports basic brand-voice cloning for agents. However, there is no documented consent process, verification step, or legal/ethical safeguard (e.g., proof of rights to the voice, consent capture, watermarking) described anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: documented consent/verification workflow for cloning a voice, safeguards against unauthorized cloning, and any independent/hands-on corroboration of the cloning quality or process.
